title: Top-open computation of the defined local stalk class with any resolution
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $y\in Y$, $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $p\in\mathbf N$. Put $c:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to Y$, $X_1=\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{Y,y}\times_Y X$, $h=\operatorname{pr}_1$, $G=\operatorname{pr}_2^*F$. For any injective resolution $K$ of $G$ and any global class $\eta\in H^p(X_1,G)$, the defined map localDirectImage_stalk_class of [def-weil-pbc-local-direct-image-stalk-class-map] sends $\eta$ to the top-open germ at $y$ of the top section class computed with $K$. More precisely, apply resolutionSectionClass of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices] to $K$, $h_*K$, the top open and the degreewise identity; then apply the top sections of the inverse right-derived resolution comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-map-via-lift], and take the germ in $c_*R^ph_*G$. This is a change-of-resolution formula without restriction to a smaller open or a restricted-resolution choice.

proof.text: Lift the identity of G from R to K. The augmentation equation gives naturality of the global-sections derived comparison and the pushforward derived comparison.

The forgetful homology comparison commutes with this lift. Naturality of exact sheafification homology and its counit gives naturality of sectionCohomologyComparison; the adjunction gives naturality of sectionCohomologyTheta. Evaluate at top, where the two section complexes are identical degreewise.

Concatenate these squares. The pushed-lift homology map disappears by naturality of the inverse right-derived resolution comparison, and the derived identity map is identity. Compose this equality with the top germ in c_*R^ph_*G and evaluate at eta. The first composite is precisely localDirectImage_stalk_class.

theorem localDirectImage_stalk_class_top_comparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y) (F : X.Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (K : InjectiveResolution
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F))
    (eta : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).toRingedSpace p ⋙
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫
          (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).appTop).hom).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F)) :
    localDirectImage_stalk_class f y F p eta =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj
          (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).rightDerived
            p).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F))).presheaf
        ⊤ y (by trivial)
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          (K.isoRightDerivedObj
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)) p).inv ⊤
          (Scheme.Modules.resolutionSectionClass K
            (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
              (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj K.cocomplex)
            ⊤ (Iso.refl _) p eta))
